title: Product 03 actual-PDF delta review after duplicate Q5 detail removal
method: Five Product 03 PDFs were regenerated from the exact remotely saved code SHA. All 35 official answers were extracted and read; 34 answer strings match the preceding reviewed PDFs, and the revised Profile 2 Q5 answer was reread and rescored with the unchanged six-part rubric. No automated quality diagnostic was used.
verdict: FAIL: profile means remain below 95; continue Product 03 improvements.

answers.questionTitle: What makes us compatible?
answers.actualPdfAnswer: This match shares a similar need for care: you value being heard before someone offers a solution; your partner values listening as well as practical help. You have common ground, but you may both wait for the other to offer it first.
answers.deductionRationale: The answer now stays on the care needs that create shared ground, instead of ending with a neutral chart comparison. The needs remain similar across these profiles and there is no example of how the shared care works between them.

answers.questionTitle: Why are we attracted to each other?
answers.actualPdfAnswer: You may be drawn to what your partner brings: reassurance, guidance and feeling understood. Your partner may be drawn to what you bring: fresh ideas and open communication. The chart cannot confirm either person's actual feelings. The day signs show neither a direct link nor a friction pattern, so they do not add a separate signal about attraction.
answers.deductionRationale: Explains each direction and states that feelings cannot be verified; the attraction traits are broad and the no-signal caveat adds length.

answers.questionTitle: What tends to cause friction between us?
answers.actualPdfAnswer: Your friction point is solving a problem before asking what help is wanted; your partner's is offering an answer before hearing how the problem feels. A tense moment may start when your response meets the different signal your partner is watching for. Say what you need before either of you assumes what the other meant.
answers.deductionRationale: Names different triggers for each partner and a likely interaction; “different signal” is vague and the closing advice is generic.

answers.questionTitle: How do emotional closeness and everyday compatibility differ?
answers.actualPdfAnswer: Emotional closeness depends more on how you respond to each other's needs; everyday compatibility depends more on how your routines work together. For emotional closeness, your charts show no clear private-life link or clash, so your personal needs are the better guide here. You value being heard before someone offers a solution; your partner values listening as well as practical help. The two charts show no direct link or clash between daily-routine patterns. Compare the personal routine styles below with the way you actually share daily life. Your daily chart pattern: Variety can be energising while too many open commitments compete for attention. Your partner's daily chart pattern: A steady rhythm can help, but comfort can also become a reason to delay a needed change.
answers.deductionRationale: Direct opener distinguishes needs from routines; both people’s needs and separate daily styles are named. The neutral signals and comparison prompt remain repetitive.
